# Crossed Zero and Native Re-entry

## #0 — The crossing has a subjectward face

The input is experience whose apparent subject and apparent objects have already been articulated. The [core spine, §IX](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) recovers the slash through both effects. Its native sequence is

`0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 → 0/1`.

Here `0` is unobjectifiable presence, `Ø` the medium's identification of itself as subject, and `X` the cut object-field. This local `X` names the field of crossings; [X/x](x-x.md) gives determining capacity its own register. The distinction lets the same graphic field retain its different operations.

## #1 — Read the fused mark

At `Ø`, the slash is fused into zero. The apparent self is encountered as one thing, while the medium that specifies it remains unavailable as a distinct operation. At `X`, that same discrimination articulates an object-world. Subject-effect and world-effect consequently appear independent even though the account derives them as two effects of the medium.

A worked recognition can begin with “I am this description.” The description is a determinate articulation; its apparent speaker takes the articulation as an exhaustive identity. Replacing the description with a more flattering one changes content within the same fusion. The required operation is to disclose the identification by which any such description comes to stand for its speaker.

## #2 — Make the slash visible

`Ø/X` separates and relates the two effects. The medium can now be recognised *as* medium. The description remains meaningful and the world remains discriminated; their relation becomes available to examination. This is the local pivot that [diaphaneity](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) carries: transparency of mediation changes the standing of what mediation presents.

The recognition does not introduce a second observer behind the first. That would repeat the fusion at another level. It makes the activity of taking-as explicit within the present relation.

## #3 — Hold both recognition-relations

The next form, `(0/Ø)/(1/X)`, has two inner strokes and an outer stroke. `(0/Ø)` relates unoccluded presence to the apparent self; `(1/X)` relates integrated unity to the discriminated field. The outer stroke holds these together as the field of availability. Cancelling identical-looking symbols would erase the very relations the form writes: these are native recognition operators, not numerical fractions awaiting reduction.

For the worked description, this means both recognising that the speaker exceeds the description and recognising that the description belongs within an integrated world. Merely rejecting every predicate would leave the object-side unreturned. The meta-relation makes inclusion and non-exhaustion available together.

## #4 — Affirm the linking one

At `1`, what appeared as the isolated `Ø` is affirmed as integrated being. The core's symbolic-linker synthesis connects this with two separately recoverable constructions. In [von Neumann's ordinal construction](../formal-neighbours/von-neumann-ordinals.md), `1={∅}` gathers the empty set as one element. In the symbolic comparison, an articulated signifier quilts a chain. The set equation is exact within set theory; its relation to recognition is the declared synthesis, not a theorem that a singleton is a subject.

The further distinction is between quilting point and thread. A particular signifier can provisionally bind an account, while the capacity for a chain to appear cannot be exhausted by one of its signs. The native account names that continuity *anusyūta*. Its historical Lacanian and Śaiva attributions remain accountable to their source houses; the present operation is the core's explicit synthesis.

## #5→0 — Return as manifest relation

The result is `0/1`: recognised presence in relation to manifestation. Pure bracketing `0` and manifest `0/1` are distinguished, so the return does not undo the world it has made available. The description can still be used, now as the ground's articulation rather than its exhaustive replacement.

This record returns-to [A10](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md), [A36](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md), and [Movement16](../../../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/16-s1-p3-crossed-zero.md). [Laws of Form and Varela](../formal-neighbours/laws-of-form-varela.md) supply neighbouring calculi with their own signatures. Native recognition retains the short definition/quilt return; an inverse process traversal must explicitly carry the full chain and its source-local primes.
